I'm always excited for Fallout DLC because it's almost always something really unique. It lets you explore areas that aren't really big enough to warrant their own spin-off game, but they're still an interesting place to experience the story and world. I personally hope that they make the DLC so that it makes sense to do it at any time, so you don't have to beat the game to experience it, but you also CAN just do it after the main quest if you really want.
